text:
Ellen (support): FYI — started getting multiple customer escalations about high p99 on /v1/generate around 11:10 UTC. Affected: hosted API, majority in us-west. p95 ~2x, p99 ~4x compared to baseline.

Ellen (support): sample errors from app traces: 
`request_id=abc123 latency_ms=2345 status=200`
`request_id=def456 latency_ms=5120 status=200`
(also a couple of 504s)

Jamie SRE: ACK. Any deploys or config changes in the last hour?

Maria (infra): no service deploys. I see a spike in queue depth on serving-pool-3 and elevated GPU memory churn on nodes g-ukr-*. CPU steal low but NVMe IO latency jumped for KV cache writes.

Ahmed (oncall): tagging mitigation checklist — start with lowest-risk rails:
  - enable short-circuit circuit breaker for heavy requests (return 503 fast)
  - shift traffic to fallback model variant (fp16-distill) in us-east
  - increase autoscale target for serving-pool-3 temporarily
  - enable prefix KV cache for common prompts

Jamie SRE: I'll flip the circuit breaker and add fallback routing. Commands:
```bash
# scale replicas quickly
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/serving-pool-3 --replicas=45
# temporary fallback: control-plane routing override
curl -X POST https://control.redwood.internal/v1/route/override \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \\n  -d '{"service":"text-gen","route":"us-east:fp16-distill","weight":0.6}'
```

Maria (infra): I deployed a KV-cache-only mode on pool-3 to reduce write amplification. Also increased IO priority on NVMe for those instances.

oncall-bot: deploy-bot noticed a rollback against model v2.3 -> v2.2 triggered at 11:25 UTC by Jamie SRE.

Jamie SRE: rolled back to v2.2 for serving-pool-3; p99 dropped ~30% in the first 5 minutes. Still above SLO, working remaining items.

Ellen (support): passing notes to customers: we rolled to previous model variant and applied temporary fallbacks; asking for any remaining reproducible payloads.

Ahmed (oncall): if regression persists after rollback, next steps:
  - enable stricter rate-limits for free tiers (early 429)
  - turn on region-failover for high-volume orgs
  - if needed, add burst capacity from Dedicated pool (contact sales/ops)

Jamie SRE: opened incident ticket INC-175350 in PagerDuty, added perf traces and flame graphs. Action items assigned:
  - Jamie: validate kernel/quantization perf regressions (30m)
  - Maria: monitor NVMe IO and revert KV-cache-only if harmful (15m)
  - Ahmed: update routing + RBAC for rollback access (10m)

Ellen (support): customers updated. They'll re-open if they still see high tail latencies. Thanks team :thumbsup:

Ahmed (oncall): follow-up note: we should add a tiny playbook snippet to the runbook for "tail-latency surge — fallback to distilled model + circuit-breaker". I'll draft it after the incident closes.

Jamie SRE: confirmed metrics now trending down to near-SLO. Keep monitoring for 1h.

Ellen (support): closing loop with customers, will file any repros we get into the incident ticket.
